Enum Class PacketType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PacketType>
global.thalion.ttio.transport.PacketType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PacketType>, Constable
public enum PacketType extends Enum<PacketType>
Transport packet types. See docs/transport-spec.md §3.2.

Cross-language equivalents: Python ttio.transport.packets.PacketType, Objective-C TTIOTransportPacketType.
